dct_title_s: Micronesia, Federated States of : Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: Building footprints across the region from OSM. Includes every feature tagged as a building (`building=*`), from residential homes through hospitals, schools, and places of worship. Useful for population estimation, damage assessment, and urban planning. OpenStreetMap is a free, collaborative world map built by volunteers. Completeness varies by region: urban areas are usually well-mapped, remote areas may be incomplete. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) - OSM tags: [Key:building](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:building) - Part of many [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot) by the [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/en/)
